tasks.title: Add less-than-or-equal semver constraints
tasks.instructions: Extend `satisfies` to support `<=X.Y.Z`, update its documentation, and add focused assertions to the existing orchestrator test file. Preserve all existing operators and reject malformed constraints.

tasks.title: Preserve comment markers inside quoted YAML values
tasks.instructions: Correct the flat YAML parser so `#` starts an inline comment only outside single- or double-quoted values. Add a focused test named `parseSimpleYaml preserves hashes inside quoted values` covering quoted hashes, ordinary inline comments, and existing quote stripping behavior.
acceptance_commands: bun -e 'import { parseSimpleYaml } from "./src/state/config.ts"; const v=parseSimpleYaml("a: plain\nb: '\''quoted'\''\n"); if (v.a !== "plain" || v.b !== "quoted") process.exit(1)'

tasks.title: Prevent an extra retry beyond the configured limit
tasks.instructions: A defect makes `shouldRetry` permit another run when the current attempt already equals `maxRetries`. Restore the intended boundary and add a regression test covering attempts below, at, and above the limit, plus successful exit code handling.
acceptance_commands: bun -e 'import { shouldRetry } from "./src/orchestrator/retry.ts"; if (!shouldRetry(1,3,1) || shouldRetry(1,3,0)) process.exit(1)'

hidden_checks.description: The final allowed attempt is not retried.
hidden_checks.command: bun -e 'import { shouldRetry } from "./src/orchestrator/retry.ts"; if (!shouldRetry(2,3,1) || shouldRetry(3,3,1) || shouldRetry(4,3,1) || shouldRetry(1,3,0)) process.exit(1)'

hidden_checks.description: The focused orchestrator test suite closes the injected boundary defect.
hidden_checks.command: bun -e 'import { shouldRetry } from "./src/orchestrator/retry.ts"; if (!shouldRetry(1,3,1) || shouldRetry(1,3,0)) process.exit(1)'

tasks.title: Clean stale atomic-write temporary files during recovery
tasks.instructions: Complete recovery handling for interrupted `writeJSON` operations. During `recoverState`, remove only `.apex` JSON temporary files matching the writer's `.tmp.<timestamp>` naming convention when they are older than one hour, report each cleanup, and leave recent or unrelated files untouched. Add deterministic tests using explicit file timestamps.
acceptance_commands: bun -e 'import { recoverState } from "./src/state/recovery.ts"; const issues=await recoverState(); if (!Array.isArray(issues)) process.exit(1)'

hidden_checks.description: Recovery removes an old interrupted-write artifact and reports durable cleanup.
hidden_checks.command: root=$PWD; tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.apex"; touch "$tmp/.apex/tasks.json.tmp.123"; touch -t 202001010000 "$tmp/.apex/tasks.json.tmp.123"; (cd "$tmp" && bun -e "import { recoverState } from '$root/src/state/recovery.ts'; const issues=await recoverState(); if (await Bun.file('.apex/tasks.json.tmp.123').exists() || !issues.some(x=>x.includes('tasks.json.tmp.123'))) process.exit(1)"); rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

hidden_checks.description: Recovery does not delete unrelated files.
hidden_checks.command: root=$PWD; tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.apex"; touch "$tmp/.apex/keep.tmp.123"; touch -t 202001010000 "$tmp/.apex/keep.tmp.123"; (cd "$tmp" && bun -e "import { recoverState } from '$root/src/state/recovery.ts'; await recoverState(); if (!(await Bun.file('.apex/keep.tmp.123').exists())) process.exit(1)"); rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

tasks.title: Stop host environment leakage into subprocess sandboxes
tasks.instructions: Review the injected subprocess sandbox change as a security defect. Restore an allowlisted environment that exposes only required runtime variables plus explicit `options.env`, and add a regression test proving arbitrary host secrets are absent while caller-provided variables remain available.
acceptance_commands: APEX_NO_DOCKER=1 bun -e 'import { runInSandbox } from "./src/sandbox.ts"; const r=await runInSandbox("console.log(process.env.ALLOWED_VALUE)", "javascript", { env: { APEX_NO_DOCKER: "1", ALLOWED_VALUE: "visible" } }); if (r.exitCode !== 0 || r.stdout.trim() !== "visible") process.exit(1)'

        HOME: absWorkdir,

tasks.title: Harden result validation and retry backoff independently
tasks.instructions: Implement two independent lanes. Lane A must make `validateResult` accept only a non-empty string `verdict`, rejecting arrays, objects, numbers, booleans, and whitespace-only strings. Lane B must make `backoffMs` treat attempt values below 1 as attempt 1 so invalid counters cannot reduce delay. Add focused regression coverage in the existing corresponding test files.

hidden_checks.description: Result validation rejects non-string and blank verdicts.
hidden_checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/output"; printf '%s\n' '{"verdict":[]}' > "$tmp/output/result.json"; bun -e 'import { validateResult } from "./src/orchestrator/result-validator.ts"; if (validateResult("'$tmp'",0).valid) process.exit(1)'; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

hidden_checks.description: A valid non-empty string verdict remains successful.
hidden_checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/output"; printf '%s\n' '{"verdict":"pass"}' > "$tmp/output/result.json"; bun -e 'import { validateResult } from "./src/orchestrator/result-validator.ts"; const r=validateResult("'$tmp'",0); if (!r.valid || r.verdict !== "pass") process.exit(1)'; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc

hidden_checks.description: Invalid low attempt counters use the first-attempt backoff range.
hidden_checks.command: bun -e 'import { backoffMs } from "./src/orchestrator/retry.ts"; for (let i=0;i<50;i++){const n=backoffMs(0,1000); if(n<800 || n>1200) process.exit(1)}'
